prompt: Elon Musk's online persona is synonymous with witty comebacks and sarcastic remarks, often aimed at individuals or institutions. What title did he humorously declare himself as in his X (formerly Twitter) bio just before closing his deal to acquire the platform, which once again stirred the online world?
answer: He humorously titled himself **“Chief Twit”** in his bio just before completing the Twitter acquisition in October 2022.
